name: Nuwan Perera
text: Excellent machine for the price. Handles Valorant and Warzone on high settings without breaking a sweat, and the 144Hz screen makes a real difference. Delivery to Kandy took three days.

name: Tharindu Silva
text: Great performance and build quality. The fans do get loud under heavy load, but the cooling keeps temperatures reasonable. Battery life is average — expect around 4 hours of normal use.

name: Amaya Rathnayake
text: Bought this for design work and light gaming. The RTX 4050 handles Premiere Pro renders nicely. Would have liked a brighter display, but at this price it is hard to complain.

name: Kasun Fernando
text: Solid laptop, but mine arrived with only 8GB of RAM installed and TechZone sorted out a replacement quickly. Good service, just check your unit on arrival.

name: Dilani Jayasuriya
text: The Victus 16 runs everything I throw at it and the 1TB drive means I am not deleting games to make room. Well worth the discount price.
